description: Defines data structures, enums, and inline functions related to DCI (Downlink Control Information) for 5G NR scheduling, including RNTI configurations and DCI format retrieval.

classes.name: cce_position
classes.description: Represents the position of a Control Channel Element (CCE) with start index and aggregation level.

classes.name: dci_dl_info
classes.description: Contains information about a downlink DCI message, including RNTI type and associated configuration union.

classes.name: dci_ul_info
classes.description: Contains information about an uplink DCI message, including RNTI type and associated configuration union.

methods.name: get_dci_format
methods.description: Retrieves the DCI format based on RNTI configuration type for downlink or uplink.

methods.name: dci_dl_rnti_config_rnti_type
methods.description: Returns a string representing the RNTI type for downlink RNTI configuration.

methods.name: dci_dl_rnti_config_format
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the DCI format for a given RNTI configuration type.

methods.name: dci_ul_rnti_config_rnti_type
methods.description: Returns a string representing the RNTI type for uplink RNTI configuration.

methods.name: dci_ul_rnti_config_format
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the DCI format for a given uplink RNTI configuration type.
